description: Use when an agent must check a person, company, vessel or aircraft against the U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list before paying, onboarding or shipping. Input: name (fuzzy, aliases included), optional type, min_score, limit. Output: JSON potential matches with score, SDN entry, programs, countries, aliases, OFAC link, list as-of date, data age. Not a legal determination. Example: ?name=Lazarus+Group Price: $0.0045 USDC via x402.

name.description: Person, company, vessel or aircraft name in Latin script; fuzzy match over SDN names and aliases

type.description: Only match this SDN entry type

name: sanctions_screen
title: OFAC sanctions name search: people, companies, vessels on the U.S. SDN list
